proposal.reason: Main functional changes are to reviewer-routing and approval policy automation: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds manual /review-module command handling, invitation synchronization, and module notice updates; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py expands gate logic to Reviewer+Maintainer requirements; and related .github/workflows/* wiring updates review/approval/preview workflow behavior. Other edits are supporting docs/skill/catalog updates for this same review workflow system, not separate runtime modules.
